findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.gen.pro" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: gen_agent_action, gen_analyze, gen_ask, gen_asset_action, gen_content_action, gen_discover, gen_generate_report_ideas, gen_platform_action, gen_publish_action, gen_sign_in_link, gen_vidsheet_action · Private data: gen_agent_action, gen_analyze, gen_ask, gen_asset_action, gen_characters, gen_content_action, gen_discover, gen_platform_action, gen_publish_action, gen_sign_in_link, gen_upload_asset, gen_watchlist_action · Public sink: gen_agent_action, gen_analyze, gen_ask, gen_asset_action, gen_characters, gen_content_action, gen_discover, gen_feedback, gen_platform_action, gen_publish_action, gen_sign_in_link, gen_upload_asset, gen_vidsheet_action · Destructive: gen_analyze, gen_ask, gen_asset_action, gen_characters, gen_content_action, gen_discover, gen_generate_report_ideas, gen_platform_action, gen_publish_action, gen_task_action, gen_upload_asset, gen_vidsheet_action, gen_voice_action, gen_watchlist_action.
